SIM records structured logs of previous AI modifications, including rationales and outcomes, allowing new models to inherit optimization experience from different model families. Unlike traditional approaches that lose contextual knowledge when switching models, SIM preserves the "why" behind code changes. Experimental results demonstrate that models equipped with SIM significantly outperform those relying solely on code transfer or cold starts, effectively enabling cumulative, recursive self-improvement in AI agent development.
